Dear Miss Yonge,
New Eng. Dictionary
Mr. [Fitzedward Hall](/person/2388) has given me a reference for Clidders to [Heir of Redclyffe](/book/15) ch. vii., which we cannot find. Would it be possible for you to send me the quotation & with the proper reference? Literary quotations for the word are not very easily got.
We know your hand well in the [earlier Dictionary material](/topic/151), though it has not been my fortune to see it often in later times.
Yours very truly,
[J.A.H. Murray](/person/1074)
